node.title: ImgFib Conjecture-F consumer descriptor and exhaustion
node.statement: Replace the prose-level conj_f charge in imgfib by an exhaustive, multiplicity-preserving map from every LIST branch that actually invokes Conjecture F to an exact linear projective split-locator section, printing the received-word branch, punctured domain, locator degree, projective dimension, root threshold, first owner, and codeword/section multiplicity. The full Pade section is polynomial rather than linear; the proved punctured root-free rational-Q projective cell is one exact subfamily, not an exhaustion theorem.
node.attack_surface: audit the actual imgfib branch partition, reuse exact proved cells, and expose any branch whose Conjecture-F charge has no parameter and multiplicity transport
node.falsifier: an omitted charged branch, a nonlinear Pade section passed as a flat, owner-swapped punctures, or loss of codeword/section multiplicity
